meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读入并组织单细胞测序产生的注释矩阵,为下游分析打好基础。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理单细胞测序结果,需要按注释矩阵整理基因表达数据。
copy.tagline_en: Read and organize annotated single-cell matrices for downstream analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle single-cell sequencing data and need a standard way to organize annotated expression matrices.

howto.what: 会用 AnnData 这个 Python 数据结构处理带注释的矩阵：创建、读写 h5ad 与 zarr 等单细胞数据文件，管理观测(obs)与变量(var)元数据，并按条件做子集、拼接和格式转换。
howto.when: 当你处理 .h5ad、zarr 等文件，或接入 scanpy、scvi-tools 等 scverse 生态工具时接管；分析流程本身仍交给 scanpy。

say.text: 把这个 data.h5ad 读进来，看看有多少细胞和基因
say.note: 以只读 backed 方式打开并报告维度

say.text: 把三个批次的 h5ad 按观测拼起来，加一列 batch 标签
留下 quality_score 大于 0.8 的细胞，另存成新 h5ad

howto.what_en: Handles annotated matrices with AnnData: creates, reads and writes .h5ad, zarr and related single-cell files, manages obs/var metadata, and subsets, concatenates or converts the data.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with .h5ad files or hook into scverse tools such as scanpy or scvi-tools; the analysis workflows themselves stay with scanpy.

say_en.text: Load data.h5ad and tell me how many cells and genes it has
say_en.note: Opens it backed (read-only) and reports dimensions

say_en.text: Concatenate the three batch h5ad files along observations with a batch label
Keep cells with quality_score above 0.8 and save them to a new h5ad
